verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.34
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.34

verses.pali: 4. Sumanavagga
verses.english: 4. With Sumanā

verses.pali: Sīhasenāpatisutta
verses.english: With General Sīha

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā vesāliyaṁ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṁ.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Vesālī, at the Great Wood, in the hall with the peaked roof.

verses.pali: Atha kho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then General Sīha went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and asked him,

verses.pali: “sakkā nu kho, bhante, bhagavā sandiṭṭhikaṁ dānaphalaṁ paññāpetun”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, can you point out a fruit of giving that’s apparent in the present life?”

verses.pali: “Sakkā, sīhā”ti bhagavā avoca:
verses.english: “I can, Sīha,” said the Buddha.

verses.pali: “dāyako, sīha, dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo.
verses.english: “A giver, a donor is dear and beloved to many people.

verses.pali: Yampi, sīha, dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṁ dānaphalaṁ.
verses.english: This is a fruit of giving that’s apparent in the present life.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, sīha, dāyakaṁ dānapatiṁ santo sappurisā bhajanti.
verses.english: Furthermore, good and true persons associate with a giver.

verses.pali: Yampi, sīha, dāyakaṁ dānapatiṁ santo sappurisā bhajanti, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṁ dānaphalaṁ.
verses.english: This is another fruit of giving that’s apparent in the present life.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, sīha, dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
verses.english: Furthermore, a giver gains a good reputation.

verses.pali: Yampi, sīha, dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṁ dānaphalaṁ.
verses.english: This is another fruit of giving that’s apparent in the present life.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṁ yadeva parisaṁ upasaṅkamati—yadi khattiyaparisaṁ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṁ yadi gahapatiparisaṁ yadi samaṇaparisaṁ—visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
verses.english: Furthermore, a giver enters any kind of assembly bold and self-assured, whether it’s an assembly of aristocrats, brahmins, householders, or ascetics.

verses.pali: Yampi, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṁ yadeva parisaṁ upasaṅkamati—yadi khattiyaparisaṁ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṁ yadi gahapatiparisaṁ yadi samaṇaparisaṁ—visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṁ dānaphalaṁ.
verses.english: This is another fruit of giving that’s apparent in the present life.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, sīha, dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: Furthermore, when a giver’s body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Yampi, sīha, dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati, idaṁ samparāyikaṁ dānaphalan”ti.
verses.english: This is a fruit of giving to do with lives to come.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, sīho senāpati bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, General Sīha said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “yānimāni, bhante, bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṁ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi; ahaṁ petāni jānāmi.
verses.english: “When it comes to those four fruits of giving that are apparent in the present life, I don’t rely on faith in the Buddha, for I know them too.

verses.pali: Ahaṁ, bhante, dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo manāpo.
verses.english: I’m a giver, a donor, and am dear and beloved to many people.

verses.pali: Ahaṁ, bhante, dāyako dānapati; maṁ santo sappurisā bhajanti.
verses.english: I’m a giver, and good and true persons associate with me.

verses.pali: Ahaṁ, bhante, dāyako dānapati; mayhaṁ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato: ‘sīho senāpati dāyako kārako saṅghupaṭṭhāko’ti.
verses.english: I’m a giver, and I have this good reputation: ‘General Sīha gives, serves, and attends on the Saṅgha.’

verses.pali: Ahaṁ, bhante, dāyako dānapati yaṁ yadeva parisaṁ upasaṅkamāmi—yadi khattiyaparisaṁ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṁ yadi gahapatiparisaṁ yadi samaṇaparisaṁ—visārado upasaṅkamāmi amaṅkubhūto.
verses.english: I’m a giver, and I enter any kind of assembly bold and self-assured, whether it’s an assembly of aristocrats, brahmins, householders, or ascetics.

verses.pali: Yānimāni, bhante, bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṁ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi; ahaṁ petāni jānāmi.
verses.english: When it comes to these four fruits of giving that are apparent in the present life, I don’t rely on faith in the Buddha, for I know them too.

verses.pali: Yañca kho maṁ, bhante, bhagavā evamāha:
verses.english: But when the Buddha says:

verses.pali: ‘dāyako, sīha, dānapati kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatī’ti, etāhaṁ na jānāmi; ettha ca panāhaṁ bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmī”ti.
verses.english: ‘When a giver’s body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.’ I don’t know this, so I have to rely on faith in the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Evametaṁ, sīha, evametaṁ, sīha.
verses.english: “That’s so true, Sīha! That’s so true!

verses.pali: Dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatīti.
verses.english: When a giver’s body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Dadaṁ piyo hoti bhajanti naṁ bahū,
verses.english: Giving, you’re loved and befriended by many people.

verses.pali: Kittiñca pappoti yaso ca vaḍḍhati;
verses.english: You get a good reputation, and your fame grows.

verses.pali: Amaṅkubhūto parisaṁ vigāhati,
verses.english: A generous man enters an assembly

verses.pali: Visārado hoti naro amaccharī.
verses.english: bold and self-assured.

verses.pali: Tasmā hi dānāni dadanti paṇḍitā,
verses.english: So an astute person, seeking happiness, <j>would give gifts,

verses.pali: Vineyya maccheramalaṁ sukhesino;
verses.english: having driven out the stain of stinginess.

verses.pali: Te dīgharattaṁ tidive patiṭṭhitā,
verses.english: They live long in the Third Heaven,

verses.pali: Devānaṁ sahabyagatā ramanti te.
verses.english: enjoying the company of the gods.

verses.pali: Katāvakāsā katakusalā ito cutā,
verses.english: Having taken the opportunity to do good, <j>when they pass from here

verses.pali: Sayaṁpabhā anuvicaranti nandanaṁ;
verses.english: they wander radiant in the Garden of Delight.

verses.pali: Te tattha nandanti ramanti modare,
verses.english: There they delight, rejoice, and enjoy themselves,

verses.pali: Samappitā kāmaguṇehi pañcahi;
verses.english: provided with the five kinds of sensual stimulation.

verses.pali: Katvāna vākyaṁ asitassa tādino,
verses.english: Having practiced the word of the unattached, <j>the unaffected,

verses.pali: Ramanti sagge sugatassa sāvakā”ti.
verses.english: disciples of the Holy One rejoice in heaven.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
